text_bubbles.text: If Lumiflow is at 120, Basic Attack 1 and 4 have longer range
can only be performed once per time in air
generates True Color on cast while in combat
takes priority over if not on cooldown
grants Party Tune Break Boost +40 for 30 seconds
becomes Interfered [Mode] when hit by any Tune Break
drains 20% per second if not moving for a while
lose all stacks upon exiting Kaleidoscopic Parade

Incoming Resonator gains for 14 seconds:
All-DMG multiplied by 1.15x
Resonance Liberation DMG multiplied by 1.25x
Lynae's DMG vs. Interfered multiplied by 1.0012x per Tune Break Boost per stack
inflicts Photochromic Flux once per 2 seconds
Dodge out of combat without directional input
generates 120 Overflow if out of combat for 2 seconds
Incoming Resonator gains All-DMG multiplied by 1.25x for 14 seconds
generate 1 stack of Premixed Hue every second while in combat, doubled out of combat
grants Spectro DMG Bonus +55% per stack of Premixed Hue on cast, then removes all stacks
drains 1 stack per 0.5 seconds if Lumiflow is below 120, halved out of combat
generates a Color of Soul stack on cast
DMG multiplied by 1.3x per stack, up to 1.9x, then removes all stacks
